verdict.rationale: Mercury Books ships Mercury Command, a built-in assistant. Users can ask it questions about their books in plain language and hand it bookkeeping tasks directly, such as writing journal entries, organizing the chart of accounts, bulk categorization, bulk GL-code assignment and creating categorization rules. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that Command reliably executes these tasks, and in-depth documentation of its command scope and limits beyond marketing copy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask Mercury Command a question about your books, or hand off a bookkeeping task to it directly, in plain language.
Offload work like writing journal entries, organizing your chart of accounts, categorization in bulk, and more.
Use Mercury Command to bulk assign GL codes, create categorization rules, and more
